description: Schema for a future admin-only family/source independence ledger. This file is not data and MUST NOT be consumed by evaluation or scoring scripts.

family_key_admin_only.description: Opaque admin identity; never export to reviewers.

source_key_admin_only.description: Opaque source identity; never export to reviewers.

public_metadata_reference.description: Citation to already-public development identity metadata only; no restricted holdout content.

reviewed_by.description: Admin/auditor role IDs; do not store reviewer identity here.

invariants: Any unknown or unresolved overlap blocks the whole family.
An eligible decision is valid only after detector and protocol freeze, full leakage inventory, reviewer conflict checks, and independent audit.
This schema and its empty template are not scoring inputs; future operational data requires a separately versioned and approved format.
